threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think £4 for a flat white is outrageous—wait 'til you discover brunch spots where it'll set you back a tenner.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week, and a guy was passionately explaining the history of the South Circular to a half-asleep passenger. Only in London.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the guy at the corner kiosk knew my order by heart, even offered me a free coffee on a rainy day. That's when I felt at home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a 24/7 Späti that sells fresh flowers alongside your late-night döner. Pure Berlin vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they instinctively know to avoid 16th and Mission during rush hour, like it’s a landmine.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing a sax on the 19 bus, serenading folks as they shuffled in. One lady handed him a dollar, but everyone just stared awkwardly.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists don’t realize that the best time for a quiet stroll in Plaça del Sol is just before dawn, when the street art is still fresh and the chatter hasn’t started.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still stop to take pictures of every building, especially during the golden hour. Old-timers just keep walking.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest Tube station, but everyone else is giving bus route numbers instead.
Last Friday, the 59 was packed with kids playing a makeshift game of poker on the floor. The bus driver just shook his head, like he'd seen it all before.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found my favorite kebab stand open at 3 AM, with the owner knowing my order by heart. That's when it felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a pub that serves currywurst with a side of techno on vinyl. Totally wild vibe after dark!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can name the best taco spot not on Mission Street and don’t just say La Taqueria.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo trying to coax a confused dog off the Muni tracks at Civic Center. Only in San Francisco do prom night and transit drama collide.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every house here is a Gaudí, but many are quaint old buildings with peeling paint that tell better stories.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by the way they still take pictures of the Templo Expiatorio del Sagrado Corazón de Jesús from the bus—locals just roll their eyes.
